subject.title: fix(diagnostics): idle ownerless state after failed recovery

question: Should a failed recovery remain strictly non-mutating, or should the recovery contract add a distinct outcome for a session proven to have no active owner across embedded, model, and tool work?
rationale: The PR changes the meaning of a failed outcome rather than only repairing bookkeeping, while current documentation defines failed outcomes as state-preserving.

options.title: Preserve failed outcomes
options.body: Keep the existing non-mutating failure contract and repair the ghost-state root cause only through a successful, explicit recovery outcome.

options.title: Add a verified ownerless outcome
options.body: Define a separate terminal recovery result only after every active-work owner is checked, then transition that result to idle with focused compatibility tests.

recommendation.title: Preserve failed outcomes
recommendation.body: Keep the existing non-mutating failure contract and repair the ghost-state root cause only through a successful, explicit recovery outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history signal for the outcome-driven recovery behavior.
